name: background-beams
blurb: Animated gradient beams sweep continuously across the viewport.
description: Renders absolute-positioned SVG with animated gradient paths flowing downward. Beams use motion/react for staggered animations and hardcoded cyan-purple-blue colors.
use_when: Hero section needing dramatic animated background without user interaction.
avoid_when: Light theme, low contrast requirements, or touch devices with performance constraints.
a11y: Passive background only; no interactive elements or focus handling.
